import json,subprocess,httpx
from pathlib import Path
before=json.loads(Path(".cache/phase2/data-services-before.json").read_text())
for entry in before:
    name="ai-trading-research-"+entry["service"]+"-1"
    actual=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect","--format",'{ "id":{{json .Id}}, "started":{{json .State.StartedAt}}, "mounts":{{json .Mounts}} }',name],text=True))
    assert actual["id"]==entry["state"]["id"] and actual["mounts"]==entry["state"]["mounts"]
print("PASSED: existing data container IDs and volume mounts preserved; stopped services were resumed.")
before_records=json.loads(Path(".cache/phase2/phase1-records-before.json").read_text())
for table,expected in before_records.items():
    query=f"SELECT count(*), md5(COALESCE(string_agg(row_to_json(t)::text, ',' ORDER BY row_to_json(t)::text),'')) FROM {table} t"
    actual=subprocess.check_output(["docker","compose","exec","-T","postgres","psql","-U","research","-d","research","-Atqc",query],text=True).strip()
    assert actual==expected,table
print("PASSED: existing Phase 1 users/accounts/risk/policies/audit counts and digests unchanged.")
for route in ("/health/ready","/api/v1/auth/status","/api/v1/safety"):
    r=httpx.get("http://127.0.0.1:18000"+route);r.raise_for_status()
    print(route,r.status_code,r.text)
